parent.description: the feature this one is stacked on, or main; absent means main, as in every record before 0.11

forked_at.description: the parent's commit the feature was branched from or last restacked onto; its own commits are forked_at..head

scanned_as.description: The mode the gate's leak scan covered; absent in a gate recorded by an older binary.

parent.description: the feature the gate stacked on; absent when it built on public main

forked_at.description: the fork point the gate replayed the feature's own commits from; absent when unstacked

base.description: the commit the feature's own commits were replayed onto (the rebased tip below); absent when unstacked

base_tree.description: base's published tree, the leak scan's baseline; absent when unstacked

below.description: every feature under this one with the head the gate built on, bottom first; absent when unstacked

commits.description: null in a gate recorded by an older binary, which promote treats as an older gate

feature_head.description: The head the publish was planned from; absent in a record written before 0.6.

branch.description: the public branch it was published to; absent before 0.11

base.description: its PR's base branch: main, or the public branch of the feature below it

published_head.description: the public branch's head as Ghostbranch last knew it

patch_ids.description: the published commits' stable patch-ids, oldest first

stack.description: the native GitHub stack its PR is in; absent when none

needs_update.description: the PR below it merged by squash or rebase while the PRs were plain chained PRs: its open public PR still carries that parent's old commits
